_difficulty_notes: hp multiplies creep health; hp_ramp (optional) adds that much to the multiplier for every wave after the first, so Hard starts close to Normal and pulls away. bounty multiplies gold income; countdown is the pause between waves in seconds.
_notes: Damage dealt = damage * multipliers[attack_type][armor_type] * armor_factor. armor_factor = 1 - (k*armor)/(1 + k*armor) for positive armor, and 2 - (1-k)^(-armor) for negative armor (shredded by venom). 'true' damage (poison) ignores both. Bosses resist slows and cannot be frozen or stunned.

easy.name: Easy
easy.description: Weaker creeps, 30 lives and a fuller purse. A relaxed first run.

normal.name: Normal
normal.description: The intended challenge: mix your towers and mind the boss waves.

hard.name: Hard
hard.description: Tougher creeps, 10 lives, less gold. Every tower has to earn its place.
